fields.name: ShardBatch<TResult> fluent step-registration API
fields.contract:
ShardBatch<TResult> Add(BatchStep<TResult> step)
ShardBatch<TResult> Add(Query query)
ShardBatch<TResult> Add(Query query, DbParameterCollection parameters)

Each overload appends one executable step to this ShardBatch<TResult> and returns that same batch so calls can be chained. The BatchStep<TResult> overload preserves the supplied step. The Query overloads append a non-result query step: the single-argument form has no supplied parameters, while the two-argument form uses the supplied parameter collection.
